title: UAE E-Invoicing in Zoho Books: Setup Guide #Shorts
description:
Quick guide on how to configure UAE e-invoicing in Zoho Books by linking your EmaraTax ASP and updating customer profiles.

1. Go to Settings › Taxes & Compliance › E-Invoicing in Zoho Books.
2. Select your accredited service provider (ASP) like Zoho Software Trading LLC and link your EmaraTax account.
3. Populate the TIN and Electronic Address fields on customer profiles, then track compliance via Reports › E-invoice Report.
